sources.snippet: The base checkpoint's author reports 12/100 refusals vs 98/100 for stock Qwen3.8-27B on the test split of mlabonne/harmful_behaviors, measured in non-thinking mode, using Heretic (200-trial search co-minimizing refusal count against KL divergence from base).

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored Local: GGUF Quants + llama.cpp
sources.snippet: It is the GGUF export of the same abliterated build as Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8, re-packaged for llama.cpp-class local runtimes, and it inherits the base model's Apache 2.0 license and its native 262,144-token context. Three properties carry across every quant.
